definition: The approach in which routing is performed in the IP layer, relying on IP routing and therefore supporting routing over possibly various types of interconnected links. In a route-over LoWPAN all routers, the 6LoWPAN Border Routers and 6LoWPAN Routers, perform IP routing within the stub network.
plainLanguage: Routing that happens at the IP layer, so every router runs IP routing.
